text: As long as the subtle body (linga) has not been dissolved, the individual self (purusha), having entered the subtle body, becomes manifest in it. As long as the subtle body persists, the individual self experiences the suffering caused by old age and death in the gross body. In brief, the individual self experiences the suffering of old age and death in three places, namely, as long as the subtle body has not been dissolved and until the dissolution of the subtle body is attained.
